source: Low occupancy can still be diagnostic. If too few warps are resident, the scheduler has fewer alternatives when one warp stalls. But the right question is not “how do I maximize occupancy?” It is “is insufficient ready work preventing the bottlenecked resource from being used effectively?”
zh: 低入住率仍然可以作为诊断依据。如果常驻扭曲太少，则当一个扭曲停止时，调度程序的选择就会减少。但正确的问题不是“如何最大限度地提高入住率？”是“现成工作不够充分，阻碍了瓶颈资源的有效利用吗？”
